On this page

The DataGrail **v2 API** enables your organization to access data and manage resources within the various DataGrail modules available in your environment.

To get started, [create an API Key](https://docs.datagrail.io/api/v2/authentication).

## Base URL [​](https://docs.datagrail.io/api/v2/\#base-url "Direct link to Base URL")

All API routes use the same base URL consisting of your organization's DataGrail URL and the API version:

```sh
https://${yourDataGrailDomain}/api/v2
```

For example, if your DataGrail URL is `camelot.datagrail.io`, each endpoint will be preceded with:

```sh
https://camelot.datagrail.io/api/v2
```
